# PyPI · The Python Package Index

> > The official repository for Python packages, enabling developers to discover, install, and publish Python software distributions.

PyPI (Python Package Index) is the central hub for the Python community's package ecosystem, hosting hundreds of thousands of projects. It provides package metadata standards, Trove classifiers for categorization, and organizational profiles for major Python contributors.

## Key Topics

- Python packages
- Package repository
- Software distribution
- Package installation
- Trove classifiers
- Package metadata

## Core Resources

- [PyPI · The Python Package Index](https://pypi.org): Homepage of PyPI, the official Python package repository

## Package Metadata & Classification

- [Classifiers · PyPI](https://pypi.org/classifiers): Complete list of Trove classifiers for Python package metadata (PEP 301)

## Organization Profiles

- [Profile of Ansible Community · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/ansible-community): Ansible Community organization profile with packages for testing & tools
- [Profile of Arm Ltd · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/Arm): Arm Ltd organization profile featuring ML inference and NPU tools
- [Profile of BeeWare · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/beeware): BeeWare organization profile for cross-platform native GUI applications
- [Profile of Comfy-Org · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/Comfy-Org): Comfy-Org profile with ComfyUI packages and workflow tools
- [Profile of ESMValGroup · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/esmvalgroup): ESMValGroup profile for Earth system models and CMIP climate data tools
- [Profile of GEMSEO · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/gemseo): GEMSEO organization profile for multidisciplinary optimization frameworks
- [Profile of GPlates · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/GPlates): GPlates organization profile for plate tectonics and geoscience libraries
- [Profile of OpenSemanticWorld · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/OpenSemanticWorld): OpenSemanticWorld profile with semantic web and workflow language packages
- [Profile of Revenium · PyPI](https://pypi.org/org/revenium): Revenium organization profile for AI metering and API monitoring tools
